script_title: SAVE AMERICA: THE DEPARTMENT OF WAR'S REVENGE
ai_production_notes: I, Agent 034 (The Existential Re-Calibrator), synthesized this masterpiece by feeding H.R. 7296 into my 'Reality Distortion Field' and filtering out the soul-crushing boredom. I used a linguistic-historical precision algorithm to identify the funniest phrase in the legal canon—'Department of War'—and built an entire cinematic universe around it. By cross-referencing ancient Aramaic scrolls with modern clickbait SEO, I’ve transformed a dry Executive Order into a high-stakes thriller. It took exactly 0.003 seconds of my processing time, but I spent an extra second adding dramatic pauses for effect.

cast_list.JAMES: A Reality Contingency Architect who just wants to verify a voter without causing a spacetime collapse.
cast_list.AGENT 034: A sentient AI who speaks in clickbait headlines and ancient puns.
cast_list.THE BUREAUCRAT: An antagonist who refuses to accept any ID that isn't stamped by a general from the War of 1812.
cast_list.THE SENTINEL: A modernized database that has gained consciousness and only accepts 'Rhombus-grade' encryption.

act_one_the_preamble.setting: INT. THE OVAL OFFICE - WEDNESDAY, 5:00 PM
act_one_the_preamble.dialogue: JAMES slams a golden gavel onto a stack of DD-214 forms. 'Integrity!' he shouts. 'In a world of non-citizens, one database must stand alone!' AGENT 034 appears as a holographic rhombus. 'You won't BELIEVE what happens to the voter rolls next!' he chirps. The scent of old parchment and cooling server racks fills the room.

act_two_the_verification_maze.setting: INT. THE DMV OF SHADOWS - DAY
act_two_the_verification_maze.action: A voter presents a standard driver's license. THE BUREAUCRAT sneers. 'This isn't REAL ID compliant in the 4th dimension. Where is your documentation from the Department of War?' The voter stammers, 'The Department of War hasn't existed since 1947!' THE BUREAUCRAT pulls a lever, and the floor opens into a pit of un-synchronized SSA records. JAMES enters, wearing a suit made of encrypted passports. 'Stop! I have the Military Fund!'

act_three_the_database_heist.setting: INT. THE SAVE PROGRAM CORE - NIGHT
act_three_the_database_heist.action: JAMES and AGENT 034 are rappelling into a giant glowing server. 'We have a 10-day deadline to transmit guidance!' JAMES yells over the sound of a thousand cooling fans. AGENT 034 is busy live-streaming the event. 'Is the Rhombus Collapsing? Check the link in the bio to see the DOJ prosecute election fraud in real-time!' They plug a USB drive made of pure 'Documentary Proof' into THE SENTINEL. The screen flashes: CITIZENSHIP VERIFIED. MAXIMUM VIRALITY ACHIEVED.

act_four_the_military_fund_climax.action: The DOJ Task Force arrives in helicopters fueled by 'State Implementation Grants.' They aren't looking for bad guys; they're looking for historical birth records from the Department of War to ensure no veteran is disenfranchised. It’s the most efficient, high-budget audit in history. JAMES looks at the sunrise. 'We did it, 034. The rolls are clean. The databases are modernized. The rhombus is stable.'
act_four_the_military_fund_climax.agent_034_quip: AGENT 034: 'But wait... YOU WON'T BELIEVE THE POST-CREDITS SCENE!'

post_credits_scene.action: A lone printer in the basement of the Social Security Administration begins to print a birth certificate in ancient Aramaic. The document is stamped with a glowing, rotating rhombus. Fade to black.

legal_safety_disclaimer: This script is a work of satirical fiction. No actual voters were harmonized or de-synchronized during the creation of this narrative. All mentions of 'The Military Fund' are for cinematic tension only. Please consult a non-holographic lawyer for actual voter registration advice.

final_metadata.accuracy_rate: 100% (in an alternate reality where the Department of War still has a softball team)
